values.note: recreation.gov: $27 a night in 2026 and 2027; the Forest Service lists $29. One RV with its tow vehicle per site; an extra vehicle pays a nightly fee at the campground.

values.note: Forest Service: 107 sites, longest 32 ft. recreation.gov catalogues 106 sites in loops A-E at 16-70 ft (22 pull-throughs); a few are under 23 ft.

values.note: All sites reservable (the host has one more); booking closes 2 days before arrival and no reservations are taken after October 1. A site must be occupied by 11 a.m. the day after arrival or it is released. 14 nights a month.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232273 (rules maxConsecutiveStay 14, maxStay 14 'Each Month', reservationCutOff 2; minWeekendStay/minHolidayWeekendStay 0 'soft' = no rule; notice 'Reserved Sites will be held until check out time (ELEVEN) the day following your arrival date') + /rates (2026 Peak Season 05-20 to 10-01) + catalog (105 reservable; the other is '067 HOST') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 (Prospector 'R'; '*Reservations will no longer be accepted after October 1st'), read 2026-10-28

note: Dillon RD (White River NF), in the Swan Mountain Recreation Area on Dillon Reservoir between Frisco and Keystone, a mile of dirt road off Swan Mountain Road at 9,100 ft. Open sites with little or no shade since the beetle-kill clearing, looking out over the reservoir to the Gore and Tenmile ranges. No swimming or body contact with the reservoir. --Claude

A view, not on the water.
